sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: NIST AI 100-1 (2023); voluntary, use-case-agnostic, versioned framework that does not define this role.

sources.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.notes: CHI 2019; general interaction guidelines require domain-specific adaptation.

sources.title: People + AI Guidebook
sources.notes: Living practitioner guide; examples illustrate design practice rather than universal outcomes.

sources.title: Software Engineering for Machine Learning: A Case Study
sources.notes: ICSE-SEIP 2019 case study; team boundaries are organization-specific.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
sources.notes: NeurIPS 2015 experience report; durable concepts with era-specific examples.

sources.title: The ML Test Score: A Rubric for ML Production Readiness and Technical Debt Reduction
sources.notes: IEEE Big Data 2017; diagnostic rubric, not a certification or universal pass score.

sources.title: Rules of Machine Learning: Best Practices for ML Engineering
sources.notes: Living engineering guide; recommendations require adaptation to product context and consequence.

sources.title: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
sources.notes: CHI 2021 qualitative research; not a prevalence estimate for all AI work.

sources.title: Everyone Wants to Do the Model Work, Not the Data Work
sources.notes: Accessible first-party summary of SRC-013, not independent corroboration.

sources.title: Bringing Personalized Search to Etsy
sources.notes: First-party 2020 marketplace case; engagement is not universal user value.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.notes: Model- and dataset-dependent calibration research; calibration is not semantic correctness or safety.

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.notes: Selective-classification formulation; application escalation and authority require separate design.

sources.title: HINT: Integration Testing for AI-based Features with Humans in the Loop
sources.notes: IUI 2022; human participation does not itself guarantee effective authority or safety.

sources.title: Online Controlled Experiments at Large Scale
sources.notes: Large online-service context; not every task can or should be randomized.

sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Voluntary organizational framework; not legal advice or a substitute for applicable authority.

sources.title: Introducing Structured Outputs in the API
sources.notes: Volatile provider-specific API example; schema conformance is not semantic correctness or authorization.

sources.title: OpenAI Model Spec
sources.notes: Living provider behavior specification; not an application contract or runtime guarantee.

sources.title: Structured Dataset Documentation: A Datasheet for CheXpert
sources.notes: Clinical imaging dataset case used for evidence and authority lessons, not clinical practice.

sources.title: How Etsy Uses LLMs to Improve Search Relevance
sources.notes: Current first-party case; reported methods and outcomes are not independent proof or universal practice.

sources.title: AI RMF Playbook
sources.notes: Living voluntary practice resource; not an ordered checklist or authorization substitute.

sources.title: Towards Automating AI System Development with AI FactSheets
sources.notes: Early versioned proposal; documentation supports accountability but does not independently verify claims.
